section_title: Section 3. Responsibility for payment of wages.
section_text: Section 3 — Every employer shall be responsible for the payment to persons employed by him of all wages required to be paid under this Act. Wages shall be paid before the expiry of the seventh day after the last day of the wage period in respect of which the wages are payable, where less than one thousand persons are employed. Failure to pay wages on time constitutes an offence under this Act and the employer shall be liable for the delayed wages plus compensation.
